title: L3 runtime verdict
description: What the runtime actually did (plan 0003 §6 runtime-verdict.json). Recorded by the runtime, read by the verifier.
x-schema-changelog: v1: decision enum was ALLOW|DENY|ERROR, and 'failure' was not declared while additionalProperties was false.

v2: adds INVALID to the decision enum for verification-only scenarios (integrity verification: a tampered ledger detected by independent chain re-computation — L3-AUD-002, THREAT-018), matching l3-plan.schema.json v2 and claim_gate P1; declares the optional 'failure' object the runtime driver already emits.

decision.description: ALLOW|DENY|ERROR for execution scenarios; INVALID for a verification-only outcome (integrity verification).

failure.description: Typed failure record when the runtime did not complete normally (class + cause, optionally recovery).
